title: Bluetti AC Status Battery Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bluetti:status battery_pct=*
| stats sum(battery_pct) as total_value, avg(battery_pct) as avg_value by model
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks model values by total and average battery percent across Bluetti AC status events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `battery_pct` values for each Bluetti AC status event and review total and average battery percent by model.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total battery percent.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly keeps which model shows the biggest battery percent numbers in your Bluetti AC status data.
